desc.title: NURİMAK TECHNICAL MACHINERY
desc.content: Nuri Teknik Makina was founded in 1980 to operate in the field of heavy industry and industrial machinery manufacturing. Specializing in metal recycling, foundry systems, and industrial automation solutions, the company provides facility-specific engineering, manufacturing, and installation services. With its experienced staff and production infrastructure, it develops reliable, long-lasting, and high-performance industrial systems both domestically and internationally.

vision.title: OUR VISION
vision.content: To become a leading engineering company that develops reliable and long-lasting industrial systems in the metal recycling and heavy industry sectors. To continuously improve production quality and operational efficiency by closely following technological advancements. To become a preferred and sustainable brand with strong domestic and international references.

mission.title: OUR MISSION
mission.content: To design and manufacture high-performance and durable industrial machines tailored to our customers’ needs. To deliver solutions that comply with engineering calculations, quality standards, and field conditions in every project. To stand by our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of our projects with strong after-sales support and long-term partnership.
